faqs.question: Do you deliver products outside the United States?
faqs.answer: No, we only deliver within the USA.

faqs.question: How do I add a prescription to my order?
faqs.answer: Register and log into your account, add the prescription in your profile, and select the added prescription in your cart.

faqs.question: How can I create my own .custom lenses?
faqs.answer: Use our .custom lens service in our store. You can choose the material, color, and other lens parameters.

faqs.question: What is the delivery time for glasses?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 5-10 business days. Express delivery is available for an additional fee and takes 1 business day.

faqs.question: Do you accept returns or exchanges?
faqs.answer: Some items may be eligible, but custom lenses, prescription lenses, electronics, and gift cards are non-returnable and non-refundable. Please review our Store Policy or contact support.

faqs.question: How should I care for my glasses?
faqs.answer: We recommend cleaning the lenses with a special microfiber cloth. Store your glasses in a case when not in use. Avoid contact with chemicals and don't leave your glasses in direct sunlight.

faqs.question: How can I verify that brand-name glasses are authentic?
faqs.answer: All our brand-name glasses are supplied directly from official manufacturers and come with certificates of authenticity. Each pair comes with an original case and documentation.
